title: [4.7 RC1] Asset Store results from inside the editor don't match website
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.7.rc1.official [a4f5e8cdd] ### System information Godot v4.7.rc1 - Windows 10 (build 19043) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21923.11000) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600GT with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 27.87 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description The results on the store's website (the new one at https://store.godotengine.org) do not match the results from searching from within the editor. Specifically, it seems results are missing when searching from inside the editor. An example is the case brought up at the end of #119578 where searching for `audio` from within the editor has the plugin [Godot Audio Manager](https://store.godotengine.org/asset/saulo-souza/godot-audio-manager/) not show up anywhere in the results despite being on the store. Searching from the website yields it as the second result: the view from within the editor: The plugin does not show up there. This issue does not seem specific to this plugin though it clearly doesn't affect all of them. I am mentioning this plugin purely because it is brought up in the above mentioned tangentially related issue and it is reproducible. I encountered this while searching for the official git plugin, which I still can't tell if it's on the new store or not: Even limiting to just MIT license results, it returns over 400 results. It seems to match the search term anywhere in the addon's text, including descriptions. Since the full name of the plugin is "Godot Git Plugin" I searched for that: Even with quotes, I can't constrain it, it just matches all the words and the results are still too many to even tell if the git plugin is anywhere in the results, without checking the entire list. The website returns 189 results for"Godot Git Plugin", limited to MIT licensed addons. The editor returns 6 pages of 24 results each, for a total of 144 results (strangely even the 6th page has the same number of results, which makes me think the results are truncated, even though the editor can show more pages, such as showing 11 for "git") for the same search string and license filter (including the quotes which make no difference). I'm guessing the official git plugin isn't yet uploaded to the new store but regardless, there are cases of addons consistently missing from the results (as in different users searching at different times get the same ones missing, if not the same results overall, over the course of weeks) as well as too many results for what should be a far more constrained search due to the terms provided, which makes it difficult to know if an addon is not there or one simply hasn't searched using the correct terms. I would otherwise not bring this up because 4.7 is barely out of beta but the RC1 post claims the store is ready to use, which may simply be referring to the website, but since it's in the post for RC1, I assume the in-editor access to it is considered functional, so this is a likely urgent bug. Also, this is probably related to functionality of the website and server as well, but I can't tell from here - the only issue the website has that I can see, related to this, is the text filter is too inclusive and flexible (matching anything in the description, including matching vaguely similar words like "audit" when you type "audio"). ### Steps to reproduce Using a 4.7 version of the editor that uses the new store url, attempt the same search from the store website (provided for convenience: https://store.godotengine.org) and from within the editor and compare results.
